_comment: Cross-language parser contract (ADR-0029). The payload parser exists twice — scripts/smc_payload_volume.py (gate) and scripts/build_pine_library_version_snapshot.ts (metric) — because the TS builder cannot import Python. Both consume these cases, so a behavioural divergence fails on the side that drifts. Keys are neutral; each suite maps them onto its own field names.

cases.name: single_literal
cases.why: The plain form: one string literal holding the whole CSV.
cases.pine:
export const int UNIVERSE_SIZE = 3
export const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS = "AAPL,MSFT,NVDA"
export const string CLEAN_RECLAIM_TICKERS = "AAPL"
export const string STOP_HUNT_PRONE_TICKERS = ""

cases.name: sharded_concatenation
cases.why: The form a healthy 6929-symbol universe actually renders as. render_csv_export splits at max_chars (3900 for UNIVERSE_TICKERS), so the export line is an expression and carries NO literal. A parser shaped like ASOF_DATE_RE scores this 0 and inverts every rule built on it.
cases.pine:
export const int UNIVERSE_SIZE = 5
const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_1 = "AAPL,MSFT"
const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_2 = "NVDA,TSLA,AMD"
export const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS = UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_1 + "," + UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_2
export const string CLEAN_RECLAIM_TICKERS = "AAPL,MSFT"

cases.name: sharded_out_of_order
cases.why: Shard order must come from the PART index, not from file order.
cases.pine:
export const int UNIVERSE_SIZE = 4
const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_2 = "NVDA,TSLA"
const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_1 = "AAPL,MSFT"
export const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS = UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_1 + "," + UNIVERSE_TICKERS_PART_2

cases.name: incident_signature
cases.why: What actually shipped: 6929 scanned, nothing in the payload.
cases.pine:
export const int UNIVERSE_SIZE = 6929
export const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS = ""
export const string CLEAN_RECLAIM_TICKERS = ""

cases.name: absent_exports
cases.why: A hand-authored library. Unknown must not collapse to a measured zero.

cases.name: prefix_collision
cases.why: NEWS_BULLISH_TICKERS and friends must not be counted as membership lists, and a longer identifier must not match a shorter export name.
cases.pine:
export const int UNIVERSE_SIZE = 2
export const string UNIVERSE_TICKERS = "AAPL,MSFT"
export const string NEWS_BULLISH_TICKERS = "X,Y,Z"
export const string EARNINGS_TODAY_TICKERS = "Q"
export const string RTH_ONLY_TICKERS = "AAPL"
